summary: Hard constraints contradict each other (RBI_VS_RESIDENCY); no compliant stack exists until one is relaxed.

warnings.message: rbi_localisation requires payment data to be stored only in India, but data_residency=eu. These cannot both hold.
Taking payments: use the gateway's hosted checkout/SDK so card data never touches your servers (PCI DSS SAQ A).

RBI storage directive (2018): the entire payment data, including backups, logs and the DR copy, must stay in India. Use an Indian DR region (e.g. AWS ap-south-2 Hyderabad / Azure South India) and keep observability data in-country.
